theater: 關東六國韓趙魏楚燕齊戰線

battle.name: 秦滅六國之戰
battle.theater: 關東六國韓趙魏楚燕齊戰線
battle.brief: 公元前230年秦內史騰取鄭滅韓起，到前221年王賁取臨淄、齊王建降為止，關東六國在十年內被逐一兼并。秦行范雎遠交近攻之策，先韓魏趙、再楚燕，終以不戰取齊。卡面的亞述長弓並非秦軍裝備，它是角筋木複合弓的祖型；秦軍真正壓制城頭的遠程兵器是弩，而六國殘兵亦以弓弩死守。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 秦滅六國之戰是公元前230年至前221年間，秦國在關中本部對韓、趙、魏、楚、燕、齊六國逐一發動的兼并戰爭，歷時約十年，最後以齊國不戰而降收場。秦一方是一部經過商鞅變法改造的耕戰機器：以縣制編戶，以五口之家為徵發單位，戰時按戶出人、編為什伍，賞罰繫於軍功爵；關中經都江堰與鄭國渠的灌溉，糧產足以支撐數十萬人長途作戰，兵器作坊則批量供應弩機、鐵鏃、銅劍、矛、戈與戟。統率上秦王政居最高位，國、尉與各卿分掌政務，主帥多帶武職封號，如武安君王翦、大良造白起、內史騰、羌憺、蒙武、辛勝、任囇與少壯將軍李信；客卿李斯與尉繚掌謀劃與法令，車騎兩司分掌戰車與騎兵。六國一方則是六套獨立的國家機器：韓據新鄭、處天下之沖而兵弱；趙有河東、太原、井陉之險，長平之後元氣未復；魏有大梁、陶郡與先登陷陣的武卒；楚地廣兵眾，車兵與地方部曲並存；燕據薊與右北平；齊有臨淄，是六國之中工商最盛而戰意最弱者。兩邊的差別不在士氣，而在能不能把幾十萬人長期保持在陣前：秦靠縣戶與渠堰，韓、趙、魏、楚、燕、齊靠世襲的封君與貴族部曲，後者一旦君主與大臣互疑，部隊就迅速鬆散。
countriesEn: The war for the destruction of the six states was a series of campaigns fought by the state of Qin from its base in Guanzhong against the states of Han, Zhao, Wei, Chu, Yan and Qi between 230 and 221 BC, lasting about ten years and ending with the surrender of Qi without a battle. On the Qin side stood a war machine remade by the reforms of Shang Yang: households enrolled by commandery, service levied on the household of five, soldiers drawn from the fields and organised in tens and fifties, with reward and punishment bound to the ranks of military merit. The Guanzhong plain, watered by the Dujiangyan works and by the Zhengguo canal, produced grain enough to keep several hundred thousand men in the field for months on end, and state workshops supplied crossbow triggers, iron arrowheads, bronze swords, spears, ge and halberds in lots. At the top of the command sat King Zheng of Qin, with the offices of state, of the chancellor and the various ministers administering the business of government; commanders in the field usually carried martial titles, such as the Lord of Wu'an, Wang Jian, the Grand Master of Works, Bai Qi, the Neishi Teng, Qiangdan, Meng Wu, Xin Sheng, Ren Ao and the Warrior of Youth, Li Xin, while the guest retainers Li Si and Wei Liao handled planning and the ordinances, and two separate directorates looked after the chariots and the cavalry. On the other side stood six independent state machines: Han holding Xinzheng at the hinge of the world but short of soldiers; Zhao with the strongholds of Hedong, Taiyuan and Jingxing, never fully recovered after the disaster of Changping; Wei with Daliang, Tao and the Wu soldiers who were first over the breach; Chu broad and populous, with chariots and local aristocratic contingents side by side; Yan holding Ji and the Right Beiping; and Qi with Linzi, the richest of the six in trade and the weakest in will to fight. The difference between the two sides lay less in morale than in the capacity to keep several hundred thousand men in front of the enemy for a long stretch: Qin could do it through its commanderies and its canals, while Han, Zhao, Wei, Chu, Yan and Qi relied on hereditary feudal lords and aristocratic contingents, and once a king mistrusted his ministers the troops of that state came apart quickly.
people: 留下姓名的多數屬於秦方。十三歲即位的秦王政（公元前259至前210年），自前230年滅韓加元、前226年荊軻事平之後加速推進，前221年統一並自稱皇帝。他最重要的文臣是李斯：荀子門人，游說秦王而得客卿，勸阻逐客，主張郡縣與統一文字，後任廷尉、丞相，滅楚前後許多決策的文書出自他手。尉繚由魏入秦，與李斯同為客卿，主張以重金離間六國君臣、拖延其合縱，是秦情報與心理戰方案的來源之一。將領之中王翦最關鍵：頻陽人，滅趙、滅楚、滅燕、滅齊四戰皆由他指揮，風格持重，反對冒進，伐楚時力主大軍必用六十萬而不接受李信二十萬的輕進方案；其子王賁以銳士破魏、燕、齊，滅魏時引鴻溝之水灌大梁，滅燕時圍薊城，滅齊時兵臨臨淄。蒙武、羌憺、辛勝、任囇各率一軍；內史騰原是韓國的內史，叛韓投秦，成了滅韓的主將；李信以二十萬伐楚而大敗，是秦軍在這場戰爭中最重的一次挫敗；樊於期原為秦將，後叛入燕，荊軻刺秦時自刭以絕荊軻之念。對面六國方面，韓王安、趙王遷、趙代王嘉、魏王假、楚王負芻、燕王喜、齊王建都是傀儡式的國君；真正起作用的是趙將李牧與龐煖在邯鄲與秦軍相持，楚將項燕在李信面前破秦二十萬，齊將田單的名聲則停留在更早以前的火牛陣上。楚考烈王與荀況已先後身故，所以楚國的敗亡是在沒有強主的情況下完成的。
peopleEn: Most of the names that survive belong to the Qin side. King Zheng of Qin (259 to 210 BC), who took the throne at thirteen, added the era name Yuan after the fall of Han in 230, pressed his pace forward once the affair of Jing Ke had been settled in 226, and in 221 completed the unification and took the title of emperor. His most important civil minister was Li Si: a disciple of Xunzi who won the ear of the king as a guest retainer, argued against the expulsion of the foreign guests, advocated commanderies and counties and a single script, and afterwards served as commandant of justice and chancellor; the documents recording many of the decisions taken around the campaigns against Chu came from his hand. Wei Liao, who came into Qin from Wei, was a guest retainer like Li Si, and urged the purchase of gold to sow dissension among the rulers and ministers of the six states and so hold back their coalition; he was one of the sources of Qin's intelligence and psychological warfare. The most important of the generals was Wang Jian: a man of Pinyang who commanded four of the campaigns, the destruction of Zhao, of Chu, of Yan and of Qi, and who was by temperament deliberate and opposed to any advance that was not properly prepared; for the war against Chu he insisted that the army must number six hundred thousand and would not accept Li Xin's plan to go in with two hundred thousand. His son Wang Ben, the striker of walls, took Wei by flooding Daliang with the water of the Honggou, took Yan by investing Ji, and took Qi when his army reached Linzi. Meng Wu, Qiangdan, Xin Sheng and Ren Ao each led a column; Neishi Teng had been the Neishi of the state of Han, and his defection to Qin made him the commander of the reduction of Han; Li Xin took two hundred thousand against Chu and was badly beaten, the heaviest reverse Qin suffered in this war; and Fan Yuqi, once a Qin general, fled to Yan and cut his own throat at the last moment so that Jing Ke's mind would be at rest. On the other side the kings of Han, Zhao, Wei, Chu, Yan and Qi were figureheads, and the men who actually mattered were Zhao's Li Mu and Pang Huan, who held the line at Handan against Qin, and Chu's Xiang Yan, who broke the twenty thousand of Qin before Li Xin. The fame of Qi's general Tian Dan belonged to an earlier age, to the fire oxen of Yan. The king of Chu and Xunzi were both dead already, so the fall of Chu was completed in the absence of any strong ruler.
kits: 先要說清楚：卡面的亞述長弓並不在秦軍的裝備表裡。亞述人自公元前九世紀起以角、筋、木三重結構做出複合弓，張力大而拉力小，是世界最早的複合弓形制；亞述弓兵站在車上射擊、車兵靠弓兵開路，兵車與弓箭配合的樣子確實是秦軍混合兵種的遠祖，但那畢竟是兩河流域的東西，沒有到過關中。真正出現在秦軍陣前的是兩樣東西：弓與弩。弓以竹木為身、角筋為力，箭鏃有石、骨、鐵三種，鐵鏃在秦墓中已是常見；弩才是秦軍遠程火力的核心，銅弩機是關鍵部件，機身機牙用銅鑄、儲力用牛筋，雲夢睡虎地秦墓與秦始皇陵陶俑坑出土的弩機構件和成束箭鏃說明這是標準化的軍用裝備。從關中作坊批量供應的還有青銅劍、矛、戟、戈與矛頭，戰國中晚期流行的鐵刃農具大量改作兵器，刃口磨損的痕跡在出土鐵器上清晰可辨。防護以皮甲為主，兼有鐵札甲片，護心鏡與甲片在秦墓中成組出土。攻城器械包括雲梯、飛石機、攻車、衝車與穴穿，挖塹築壘、掘進坑道是這場十年戰爭裡的基本功。運輸靠牛車、馬車與大批轉輸丁夫，魏國開鑿的鴻溝渠系把黃河與淮泗接通，秦沿線設倉儲糧，是東征能夠持續的關鍵。水攻也在器械之列：滅魏時秦軍利用鴻溝之水灌大梁，一座百萬人口的大城是被水逼降的。
kitsEn: One thing has to be said first: the Assyrian bow on the card was not in the Qin army's inventory. The Assyrians, from the ninth century BC, built composite bows of horn, sinew and wood, with great draw weight and low power, the earliest composite bow form known; the Assyrian archer shot from the cart and the chariot troops opened the way for the archers, and that pairing of war cart and bow is indeed the distant ancestor of Qin's mixed arms, but it was a thing of the Two Rivers that had never reached Guanzhong. Two things stood on Qin's battlefield: the bow and the crossbow. The bow was bamboo and wood with horn and sinew for its power, its arrowheads of stone, bone and iron, with iron heads already common in Qin burials; but the crossbow was the core of Qin's long-range firepower, and the bronze trigger was the critical component, the body and the lock cast in bronze and the power stored in animal sinew. The trigger fittings and bundled arrowheads excavated from the Qin tomb at Shuihudi in Yunmeng and from the terracotta pits of the First Emperor's mausoleum show that this was standard issue kit. Also supplied in lots by the workshops of Guanzhong were bronze swords, spears, halberds, ge and spearheads, and the iron-bladed farm tools that had spread through the later Warring States period were largely turned into weapons, the wear along the edges clearly visible on excavated iron. Protection was chiefly hide, with iron plates fastened over it, and cuirass plates and mirrors for the chest were found in groups in Qin burials. The siege equipment included scaling ladders, stone-throwers, battering carts, rams and the digging of tunnels, and the raising of ramparts and the driving of ditches were the basic skills of this ten-year war. Transport rested on ox carts, horse carts and a great many porters in the service of the army; the Honggou canal system cut by Wei joined the Yellow River to the Huai and the Si, and the granaries Qin set up along that line were the key to the durability of the eastern campaigns. Water attack belonged to the list of devices as well: when Wei was destroyed, the Qin army used the water of the Honggou to flood Daliang, and a city of a million people was brought to its knees by water.
tactics: 這場戰爭的打法可以分層看。最高一層是范雎提出的遠交近攻：先取近處的韓、魏，暫時拉攏遠方的楚、燕、齊，避免六國組成反秦聯盟；每取一城一邑都要先拿到手，用時間換取縱深。第二層是逐國解決，絕不同時在幾條戰線上打大仗：前230滅韓、前228滅趙、前225滅魏滅楚、前222滅燕與代、前221滅齊，兩國滅亡之間留出數年的間隙，讓剛奪得的土地先完成接管。第三層是按對手特點換手段：對韓用內應，內史騰以韓國內史的身分開城；對趙用反間，秦人買通趙王的左右，進讜言說李牧與趙王不睦，李牧被趙王遷所殺，邯鄲的防線由此瓦解；對魏用水攻，王賁引鴻溝之水灌大梁，穀盡民困而魏王假降；對楚用消耗，王翦率六十萬至新鄭之後堅壁不戰，下令敢於交戰者斬，等到楚兵東移才追上去，於壽春一帶大破之，楚國主力盡喪；對燕用圍城與追擊，王賁軍至薊，燕王喜乞降而後走保遼東，秦軍一路追到遼東，燕國覆亡；對齊用金錢與離間，齊相受秦國賄賂，齊王建遂不戰而降。兵種層面上，秦軍以弩兵壓制城頭、以車兵與步卒結陣推進、以騎兵迂迴追擊殘敵，攻城則配合坑道、雲梯與飛石；後勤上靠鴻溝與洛陽一線的倉儲轉輸維持東征。整場戰爭的關鍵不在某一場會戰，而在節奏：秦在每一戰都留有餘力，在每一國滅亡後立刻轉兵他方。
tacticsEn: The conduct of this war can be read in layers. The highest layer is the strategy of Fan Ju: win distant allies and attack the near, taking Han and Wei first while holding off Chu, Yan and Qi, so as to prevent the six states from forming an anti-Qin coalition; every city and every strip of ground taken was to be grasped at once, trading time for depth. The second layer is the resolution of one state at a time, and never a great battle on several fronts at once: Han falls in 230, Zhao in 228, Wei and Chu in 225, Yan and Dai in 222, Qi in 221, with intervals of years left between the falls so that the ground just taken could be brought under control first. The third layer is the choice of means for each opponent. Against Han, an insider: Neishi Teng opened the city in his capacity as the Neishi of the state of Han. Against Zhao, dissension: Qin bought over the persons around the king of Zhao and planted the word that Li Mu was not at one with the king; Li Mu was put to death by King Qian, and the line at Handan fell apart in consequence. Against Wei, water: Wang Ben brought the water of the Honggou down upon Daliang, and with the grain spent and the people in distress the King of Wei, Jia, surrendered. Against Chu, attrition: Wang Jian brought six hundred thousand men to Xinzheng and then simply refused to fight, ordering that any soldier who engaged be beheaded; only when the Chu army had moved east did he follow it, catching it near Shouchun and breaking it, and the main body of the Chu army was lost. Against Yan, investment and pursuit: Wang Ben's army reached Ji, the king of Yan begged to surrender and then fled to keep himself in Liaodong, and the Qin army followed him all the way, and Yan perished. Against Qi, money and dissension: the chancellor of Qi took Qin's gold, and the king of Qi, Jian, surrendered without a battle. At the level of arms, the Qin army used crossbowmen to pin the walls, war carts and foot in formed advance to push the line, and cavalry to swing round and run down the broken; in sieges it worked with tunnels, scaling ladders and stone-throwers. On the logistics side, the granaries and the chain of transport along the Honggou and the Luo river line kept the eastern campaigns supplied. The key to the whole war lay not in any single battle but in tempo: Qin kept something in hand out of every engagement and turned its troops onto another front as soon as a state had fallen.
data: 可核對的數字分幾類。年代：秦王政十七年（公元前230年）內史騰取鄭、滅韓為始，至二十六年（前221年）齊王建降為終，前後約十年；六國的滅亡次序在《史記·六國年表》與《秦始皇本紀》一致，只是個別年份有前一年的出入。月份：《史記》未記明開戰月，本卡取七月。兵力：《史記·白起王翦列傳》記王翦伐楚「非六十萬人不可」，李信伐楚亦稱二十萬；同一套編戶制度下秦的可徵兵在數十萬量級，而後世學者依田地、戶籍與兵役負擔推估戰國中晚期的人口在二千萬至三千萬之間，這是推算而不是文獻所記。距離：按今地圖直線計算，咸陽東至韓都新鄭約四百六十公里，至魏都大梁約五百一十公里，至趙都邯鄲約五百九十公里，至楚都壽春約六百公里，至齊都臨淄約九百一十公里，至燕都薊約九百三十公里；秦軍的糧道與後勤要覆蓋這些距離。水利：都江堰築於秦昭王之世，鄭國渠開鑿於前246年，《史記·河渠書》稱其「溉田四萬餘頃」，關中因此能養活大軍。郡制：秦統一天下後設郡，《史記》作三十六郡，後世考訂多作三十九郡，說法不一。考古：秦始皇陵兵馬俑一號坑長約二百三十米、寬約六十二米，坑內陶武士俑近六千件，東側排列著戰車；雲夢睡虎地秦墓出土成組竹簡與銅弩機，兵器作坊的分批量產由此可見。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked fall into several classes. Dates: the seventeenth year of King Zheng of Qin (230 BC), when Neishi Teng took Zheng and Han was destroyed, is the beginning, and the twenty-sixth year (221 BC), when the king of Qi, Jian, surrendered, is the end, giving about ten years; the order in which the six states fell is the same in the Shiji's Table of the Six States and in the annals of the First Emperor, though individual years differ by a year in places. Months: the Shiji does not record the month in which the war opened, and the month taken here is July. Strength: the Shiji in the biographies of Bai Qi and Wang Jian has Wang Jian say of the war against Chu that without six hundred thousand men it could not be done, and Li Xin's expedition against Chu is also given as two hundred thousand; under the same system of household enrolment the men Qin could call up ran to the hundreds of thousands, while later scholars, estimating from the land, the household registers and the burden of service, put the population of the later Warring States period at between twenty and thirty million, which is an inference and not something the documents record. Distances: measured as the crow flies on a modern map, Xianyang lies about four hundred and sixty kilometres east of the Han capital at Xinzheng, about five hundred and ten from Daliang, the Wei capital, about five hundred and ninety from Handan, the Zhao capital, about six hundred from Shouchun in Chu, about nine hundred and ten from Linzi, the Qi capital, and about nine hundred and thirty from Ji, the Yan capital; the grain roads and the logistics of the Qin army had to cover those distances. Waterworks: the Dujiangyan works were raised in the reign of King Zhaoxiang, and the Zhengguo canal was begun in 246 BC, the Shiji in the Rivers and Canals chapter saying that it watered more than forty thousand qing of land, and Guanzhong could therefore feed a great army. Prefectures: after the unification Qin set up commanderies, the Shiji giving thirty-six and later scholarship settling on thirty-nine, the accounts differing. Archaeology: the first pit of the terracotta army of the First Emperor's mausoleum is about two hundred and thirty metres long and sixty-two wide, with close on six thousand terracotta warriors in it and war chariots ranked along its eastern side; the Qin tomb at Shuihudi in Yunmeng yielded the large set of bamboo slips together with bronze crossbow triggers, and the mass production of weapons by the workshops is visible in them.
cause: 打起來有六層原因，逐層相扣。最底下一層是制度：商鞅自公元前356年起變法，把秦國改造成以軍功為唯一晉身之道的國家，縣制、什伍連坐與五口之家的編戶使秦能反覆抽調幾十萬人；沒有這套制度，前230到前221年間的十次大規模出征根本無法進行。往上一層是地理與經濟：關中四塞，八百里秦川，函谷、潼關與崤山構成唯一的東進通道，秦佔上游，水利興修與糧產都優於關東，所以秦耗得起消耗戰。往上一層是歷史進程：從秦孝公到秦昭襄王，秦已先後取得河西、漢中、上郡，安邑入魏、上黨入趙，白起拔郢、上柱國破趙，六國的疆界被一寸寸推平到只剩韓、趙、魏、楚、燕、齊；前230年不是爆發點而是收官點。再上一層是戰略選擇：遠交近攻打掉聯盟的可能，逐國解決避免多線作戰，再按對手特點選內應、反間、水攻、消耗、圍城與賄賂。對面的弱點也在這裡：六國在戰國後期只剩互相攻伐的舊習慣，彼此不信任，縱橫的聯盟每次都因君主與大臣的私心破裂；而秦用反間逐個拔掉對方最能打的將領，李牧之死就是最典型的例子。最上面還有兩件加速的事：前237年李斯議逐客與前227年荊軻刺秦。兩者都不是秦攻六國的深層理由，卻讓秦王對六國的疑心與壓迫同步加深，情報與反間手段也隨之更趨激烈。
causeEn: There are six layers of cause, each resting on the one below. The lowest is institutional. From 356 BC onward Shang Yang reformed Qin into a state in which military service was the only road of advancement: the commandery system, the mutual responsibility of groups of ten and fifty and the enrolment of households of five allowed Qin to call up several hundred thousand men over and over; without that machinery the ten great campaigns between 230 and 221 BC could not have been mounted at all. Above that lies geography and economics. Guanzhong is girt about, eight hundred li of plain, and the Hangu, Tongguan and Xiaoshan defiles form the only corridor east; Qin held the upper reaches, and its waterworks and its harvests were better than those east of the passes, so Qin could afford the war of attrition. Above that lies the historical process: from Duke Xiao of Qin to King Zhaoxiang, Qin had taken Hexi, Hanzhong and Shangjun, Anyi had gone to Wei and Shangdang to Zhao, Bai Qi had taken Ying and the chancellor Wang Jian had broken Zhao, and the frontiers of the six states had been pared away inch by inch until only Han, Zhao, Wei, Chu, Yan and Qi remained; 230 BC was not the moment the war broke out but the moment it was finished. Above that lies the choice of strategy: winning distant allies and attacking the near to destroy any possibility of a coalition, resolving one state at a time so as never to fight on several fronts, and then picking the right means for each opponent, an insider, dissension, water, attrition, investment or bribery. The weakness of the other side lay in the same place: by the later Warring States period the six states had kept only the old habit of attacking each other, they no longer trusted one another, and every coalition broke up over the private quarrels of kings and ministers; meanwhile Qin used dissension to remove the ablest commander of the enemy one at a time, and the death of Li Mu is the clearest case. At the top there are two events that hastened the process: the proposal to expel the foreign guests in 237 BC and the attempt on the king by Jing Ke in 227 BC. Neither was the deep reason for Qin attacking the six states, but both deepened the king's suspicion and his pressure upon them at once, and Qin's intelligence and counter-intrigue grew sharper in step.
impact: 這場戰爭結束後留下三樣東西。第一是中國第一個中央集權帝國的雛形：郡縣取代分封，軍功爵出身者充當官僚，編戶齊民把全國人口固定在國家名冊上，秦律與軍法被後世法系繼承，《睡虎地秦簡》所出的秦律、秦式、秦令是這一點最直接的物證。第二是技術與制度的標準化：書同文，度量衡與車軌統一，貨幣收歸半兩，兵器由中央作坊按同一規格量產；軍制上弩的戰術化、車兵向騎兵的轉型、進攻性野戰與攻城器械的系統化，都在此時定型，《孫子兵法》《尉繚子》一類兵書也在這個氛圍裡成形。第三是後世的政治框架：漢承秦制，郡縣與官僚成為兩千一百年帝制的基本骨架，後人講秦不是因為秦朝長久，而是因為秦朝之後的每一個王朝都長得像秦。第三是它的反面：秦朝並沒有因此長壯。統一之後立刻北擊匈奴、築長城與馳道、大興土木、加重徭賦，前213年李斯議禁私學、令非秦記皆燒之，前212年又坑術士於咸陽，把行政手段推到了極限；前209年陳勝吳廣在大澤鄉舉兵，前207年鉅鹿一役秦軍主力覆沒，前206年劉邦入關、秦亡。十年併六國的戰爭，開出了一個帝國，也把它推到了崩潰的邊上。
impactEn: Three things were left behind when this war ended. First, the embryo of the first centralised empire in China: commanderies and counties took the place of enfeoffment, men raised by military merit became officials, the registration of the people fixed the whole population of the country on the rolls of the state, and the laws and military ordinances of Qin were inherited by later legal systems, of which the Qin statutes, forms and ordinances recovered from the bamboo slips of Shuihudi are the most direct physical evidence. Second, the standardisation of technique and institution: a single script, unified weights and measures and the gauge of the cart, the coinage brought back to the half-liang, and weapons turned out in the central workshops to one pattern; in military terms the tactical use of the crossbow, the turn of the war cart into cavalry, the offensive open battle and the systematisation of siege equipment were all fixed at this time, and works such as the Sunzi Bingfa and the Wei Liaozi took shape in the same climate. Third, the political frame of later ages: Han took up the institutions of Qin, and commanderies with a salaried bureaucracy became the basic frame of the imperial system for two thousand one hundred years; men speak of Qin not because the Qin dynasty lasted, but because every dynasty after it was built in the same shape. Third as well, its reverse: the Qin dynasty did not grow stronger for it. Immediately after the unification it struck north against the Xiongnu, built the long wall and the post roads, threw up great works, and weighted the corvée; in 213 BC Li Si proposed to forbid private learning and to burn all books that were not Qin records, and in 212 BC the practitioners of the occult arts were buried alive at Xianyang, carrying administrative means to their limit; in 209 BC Chen Sheng and Wu Guang raised the standard at Dazexiang, in 207 BC the main body of the Qin army was destroyed at Julu, and in 206 BC Liu Bang entered the passes and Qin was gone. A war that swallowed the six states in ten years opened up an empire and pushed it to the edge of collapse.
result: 公元前221年，齊王建率齊國降於王賁，臨淄落入秦軍之手，六國至此盡滅；從前230年取鄭到這一年，前後十年，秦王政完成統一，同年稱皇帝、廢分封置郡縣、統一文字度量衡貨幣與車軌，疆域依《史記》所載東至海暨朝鮮，西至臨洮、羌中，南至北向戶，北據河塞。戰役層面的結果可以逐場說：韓以內史騰之叛而速亡，趙在李牧被反間除去之後，邯鄲的防線被突破，魏都大梁被水灌而迫降，楚在壽春一戰主力盡喪之後數年而亡，燕在薊城與遼東兩度崩潰，齊則幾乎沒有打過一場像樣的仗。同一場戰爭的另一面結局出現在十五年後：前209年陳勝吳廣起義於大澤鄉，前208年秦將章邯節節敗退，前207年項羽在鉅鹿破秦軍主力，前206年劉邦軍入武關、子嬰素車降而仍為項羽部將所殺，秦王族在沙丘宮中被害，秦朝覆亡。所以最終可以這樣總結：秦滅六國之戰的軍事結果，是關東六國的國家機器被逐一拆掉，統一的中國由此成立；而它的政治結果，是同一個政權在十五年裡走完全部路程——秦靠這場戰爭得到天下，卻用征服六國的辦法去治理天下，於是天下在統一後第十二年揭竿而起。
resultEn: In 221 BC the king of Qi, Jian, surrendered Qi to Wang Ben, Linzi fell into the hands of the Qin army, and the six states were thereby extinguished; from the taking of Zheng in 230 BC to that year, ten years had passed, and King Zheng of Qin completed the unification, in the same year taking the title of emperor, abolishing enfeoffment and setting up commanderies, and making the script, the weights and measures, the coinage and the gauge of the cart uniform, the territory being described in the Shiji as reaching east to the sea and to Choson, west to Lintao and the Qiang, south to the northern side of the Bei caves, and north to the passes of the Yellow River. The result can be told campaign by campaign. Han fell quickly through the defection of Neishi Teng; Zhao lost the line of Handan after Li Mu was removed by counter-intrigue; Wei's capital of Daliang was flooded and forced to surrender; Chu perished within a few years of the rout of its main army at Shouchun; Yan broke down twice, at Ji and in Liaodong; and Qi scarcely fought a proper battle at all. The other face of the same war appeared fifteen years later: in 209 BC Chen Sheng and Wu Guang rose at Dazexiang; in 208 BC the Qin general Zhang Han was driven back step by step; in 207 BC Xiang Yu broke the main body of the Qin army at Julu; and in 206 BC the army of Liu Bang entered Wuguan, the lord of Qin came out in a plain carriage to surrender and was killed by a general of Xiang Yu nevertheless, and the royal house of Qin was done to death in the palace at Shaqiu, and the Qin dynasty was gone. The result can therefore be summed up in two clauses. The military result of the war for the destruction of the six states was that the state machines of the six states were dismantled one by one and a unified China was established; the political result was that the same regime travelled the whole distance in fifteen years. Qin won the realm in this war, and then tried to govern the realm by the methods with which it had conquered the six states, and the realm rose in arms in the twelfth year after the unification.
